name: Justine Meehan
title: Psychologist
description: Justine is a registered psychologist and EMDR therapist, highly skilled in supporting people to overcome the impacts of trauma. She provides counselling and EMDR Therapy for adolescents, adults and parents/carers experiencing complex trauma, PTSD, depression, anxiety, relationship issues, parenting and family conflict.
specialties: Complex trauma, PTSD, EMDR, Adolescents, Parenting

name: Leonardo Cistullo
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Leo is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and EMDR therapist who works with adults experiencing trauma-related distress, anxiety, depression, grief and loss and relationship difficulties. His approach is EMDR-led and integrated with ACT, CBT-informed strategies and attachment-informed work. Leo warmly welcomes people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds and is LGBTQIA+ affirming.
specialties: Trauma, EMDR, LGBTQIA+ affirming, Grief, CALD

name: Lindy Noblet
title: Psychologist
description: Lindy is a registered psychologist and EMDR therapist. Her approach is flexible and collaborative, drawing from Interpersonal Therapy, Person-Centred Therapy, Internal Family Systems, Mindfulness, and EMDR. Sees clients Wednesdays and Thursdays.

name: Madeleine Jablonski
title: Clinical Lead, Psychologist & Accredited EMDR Consultant
description: Madeleine supports people with trauma (including complex childhood trauma), family violence, sexual assault and identity issues. She has a special interest in dissociative disorders like DID, grief and loss and spiritual aspects of psychology. She welcomes people from the LGBTQI+ community and teams EMDR with animal assisted therapy, parts work, ACT, solution focused therapy and schema-focused therapy.
specialties: Dissociative disorders, DID, Complex trauma, EMDR, Parts work, Schema therapy, LGBTQI+, Animal assisted therapy

name: Nikki Pascarl
title: Psychologist
description: Nikki is a registered psychologist and Accredited EMDR Practitioner working with adults, with a particular interest in trauma and the ways it impacts people's lives, such as PTSD and complex PTSD, borderline personality disorder and substance misuse. Her primary framework is EMDR Therapy, complemented by CBT, ACT, MI, Schema Therapy, DBT and 'parts work'.
specialties: PTSD, Complex PTSD, EMDR, Schema Therapy, Parts work, BPD, Forensic

name: Sam Dachs
title: Clinical Lead, Accredited Mental Health Social Worker, Family and Couple Therapist
description: Sam is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker, Family and Couple Therapist, and Accredited EMDR Practitioner. His framework draws on EMDR, psychodynamic psychotherapy, narrative therapy, ACT and parts work, and he is particularly interested in supporting people navigating anxiety, complex PTSD and relational trauma. Now based rurally, Sam offers telehealth with Mindful Living.
specialties: Complex PTSD, Relational trauma, EMDR, Parts work, Couples therapy

name: Sarah Hinrichsen
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Sarah is a clinical psychologist and EMDR therapist particularly interested in working with individuals with PTSD and Complex PTSD, and in helping clients to understand and heal from shame and abuse. She draws from EMDR, Interpersonal Therapy, CBT, Mindfulness, ACT and DBT.
specialties: PTSD, Complex PTSD, EMDR, Abuse, Personality disorders

name: Sarah McEwen
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
identity: A parent in her 40s with lived experience of neurodivergence
description: Sarah is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker, EMDR therapist and Tuning in to Kids facilitator. She draws from EMDR, Polyvagal Theory, CBT, ACT and mindfulness, and is particularly interested in working with young people, depression, low self-esteem, perfectionism, and attachment wounds.
specialties: EMDR, Young people, Attachment wounds, Perfectionism

name: Susie Collins
title: Counsellor & Social Worker
description: Susie is a Social Worker, Counsellor, and EMDR trained therapist with a particular interest in complex trauma, neurodiversity (autism and ADHD) and personality disorders. Susie is an LGBTQI+ ally and a neurodiversity affirming practitioner. Her work is informed by ACT, CBT, Schema Therapy, and DBT.
specialties: Complex trauma, EMDR, Schema Therapy, LGBTQI+ ally, Neurodiversity affirming

name: Tegan Carleton
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Tegan is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and EMDR therapist with experience supporting individuals and families impacted by trauma, sexual assault, family violence, and ongoing life stress. She enjoys working with people from the LGBTQIA+ community and is committed to providing inclusive, affirming, and compassionate therapy.
specialties: Trauma, Sexual assault, Family violence, EMDR, LGBTQIA+
